- **NCLB reference** (top-left panel): Nearly identical — large cigar-shaped lesion, same tan center with darker margins on a green leaf. Perfect match
- **Anthracnose leaf spot**: Much smaller lesions, intensely dark (nearly black) borders, black setae — doesn't match
- **Gray leaf spot**: Narrower rectangular lesions with strictly parallel vein-bounded edges — doesn't match the smooth tapered ends
- **Carbonum leaf spot**: Oval lesions with concentric rings — doesn't match
- **Southern corn leaf blight**: Small rectangular spots — doesn't match

The test image is a textbook example of **Northern_corn_leaf_blight** — the large, single cigar-shaped lesion with tan center and reddish-brown margins is the defining feature.
